_comment: Shared cases for the number check of machine-written texts: export/genai.py (tests/test_export_genai.py) and web/lib/genai.ts (web/tests/unit/genai.test.ts) must agree on every one. The lanes cases are the lane-word rule (check_lanes, checkLanes). The directions cases are the word-of-change rule (check_directions, checkDirections). The subjects cases are the subject rule (check_subjects, checkSubjects).
